features: Protect & Elevate Your Bedding - Mellanni King Size Duvet Cover Set includes 1 protective duvet cover 90" x 104", 2 matching Pillow Shams 20" x 36" with 2" flange and 2 Bonus Pillow Cases 20" x 40" included for free. Enhance your bed and safeguard your duvet or weighted blanket from spills, stains, sweat, & more.

Built To Last - Buttery-soft yet ultra-durable, our duvet cover is made from the same 100% double-brushed microfiber as our beloved Iconic Collection bedsheets. Keep your duvet firmly in place with the 4 corner ties. Hidden button closure for easy on & off - no broken zippers.

Easy Care & Low Maintenance - Fade, stain, shrink, & wrinkle resistant. Eliminate the need to wash expensive duvets or heavy blankets, saving time & reducing energy costs. Compatible with different weight duvets for every season. Machine wash cold, dry on tumble dry low.

Mix & Match with Mellanni - The included pillowcases with 5 cm flange envelope closure instantly upgrades your bed’s look & feel. Pairs perfectly with other Mellanni products to seamlessly match your decor. A great gift idea for any occasion.

Award-Winning & Risk-Free Comfort - Loved by over 10 million sleepers, this 6x Good Housekeeping Award Winner has been featured on The Today Show, Oprah Daily, CNN, and more. Plus, with the Mellanni Lifetime Promise on your purchase item, and over ten-year track record, buy and return with confidence!
